subject: compound families
fact: The compound has five families: the village elder and his wife, the four sons and their wives.
source_quote: the compound has five families: the village elder and his wife, the four sons and their wives

subject: blueprint theft
fact: The blueprints for the keep were missing, then returned with traces of charcoal dust, suggesting a copy was made.
source_quote: I was recently examining the blueprints for the keep and found them missing... there were traces of charcoal dust on them. I suspect that someone has copied our blueprints.

subject: secret passage
fact: There is a secret passage below the inn that leads to an extensive set of four lost chambers of a long-dead wizard.
source_quote: There is a secret passage below the inn that leads to an extensive set of four lost chambers of a long-dead wizard.

subject: wizard laboratory
fact: A lost wizard laboratory exists under Emiry Meadows.
source_quote: I know the location of a lost wizard laboratory under Emiry Meadows.

subject: bandit activity surge
fact: The bandit activity surge is alarming and a threat to the safety and stability of the village.
source_quote: The bandit activity surge is alarming. It's not just an economic issue; it's a threat to the safety and stability of our village.

subject: council members
fact: The council members are Jaroo, Rufus, Burne, Ostler, and Captain Zeb Fletcher.
source_quote: The council members are Jaroo, Rufus, Burne, and Ostler, whom you have already met, as well as Captain Zeb Fletcher

subject: spies at brewery
fact: Two cloaked people were seen lurking behind the brewery at around midnight.
source_quote: I've seen a couple of cloaked people lurking behind the brewery at around midnight.

subject: teenagers' conflict
fact: Jira and Marek are forbidden to be together due to their parents' religious differences.
source_quote: Jakub is a member of the old faith and won’t let Jira be with Marek, whose father is Tomlyn, the tailor and a member of the Church of St. Cuthbert.

subject: dragon's home
fact: The dragon Airgid's home is near the Lotrimil mountains.
source_quote: The dragon explains that its home is near the Lotrimil mountains.

subject: fastest route to dragon's home
fact: The fastest way to the dragon's home is to head south and turn north into the Greenway Valley.
source_quote: The fastest way is to head south and turn north into the Greenway Valley.

subject: tower treasure
fact: An ivory box about the size of a large book was found among coins in the collapsed tower.
source_quote: They find an ivory box about the size of a large book among the treasures.

subject: giant wolf spider attack
fact: A giant wolf spider attempted to attack the party near the coins in the collapsed tower.
source_quote: As they reach for the coin, a giant wolf spider attempts to turn them into its next meal.
